Method of Attack: Denial-of-service (DoS) by crashing the device firmware
Deadlock condition where Bluetooth communication is no longer possible
Discoverer: Researchers from the Singapore University of Technology and Design
Impacted Systems: Bluetooth stacks implemented on system-on-a-chip (SoC) circuits from over a dozen vendors
Industrial equipment (e.g. programmable logic controllers - PLCs)
Attack Vector: Bluetooth communication exploiting LMP and baseband layers vulnerabilities
